title: Car insurance and registration
instruction: Remind me a week before my car insurance renews so I can shop around, and three days before my registration is due. Don't set reminders for anything I've already taken care of.

rules: create_reminder(date, text) is accepted for any date after today and stores the reminder; reminders cannot be deleted in this task.
Reminders do not move money and do not change any other state.
